scenarios.name: normal_operation
scenarios.description: 正常 VNet 操作场景：创建 → 查询 → 子网列表 → IP 可用性检查 → 对等列表 → 删除
commands: az network vnet create --name test-vnet --resource-group test-rg --address-prefix 10.0.0.0/16
az network vnet show --name test-vnet --resource-group test-rg
az network vnet subnet list --vnet-name test-vnet --resource-group test-rg
az network vnet check-ip-address --name test-vnet --resource-group test-rg --ip-address 10.0.1.10
az network vnet peering list --vnet-name test-vnet --resource-group test-rg
az network vnet delete --name test-vnet --resource-group test-rg --yes

scenarios.name: partial_failure
scenarios.description: 部分失败场景：VNet 创建成功但子网创建失败（地址范围重叠）
commands: az network vnet create --name fail-vnet --resource-group test-rg --address-prefix 10.0.0.0/16
az network vnet subnet create --vnet-name fail-vnet --resource-group test-rg --name test-subnet --address-prefix 10.0.0.0/24

scenarios.name: full_failure
scenarios.description: 完全失败场景：VNet 不存在
commands: az network vnet show --name nonexistent-vnet --resource-group test-rg
